convert_t5x_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a T5X checkpoint to a PyTorch checkpoint using a config file and output path
convert_t5x_to_pytorch: convert T5X-Flax model parameters to PyTorch state dict for encoder-only or encoder-decoder models
load_t5x_weights_in_t5: load T5X checkpoint weights into a UMT5 PyTorch model with configurable encoder-only and scalable attention
make_state_dict: prepare a PyTorch state dict from converted T5X parameters with shared embeddings and lm head fallback
convert_umt5_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI to convert a UMT5 T5X checkpoint to PyTorch with optional encoder-only and scalable attention flags
